answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the ember seed, the comet timing is verifiable from the umber record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 219 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is cheap once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 91 keys thus pays 91 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. That is 6 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
